display_title: How to Reconcile Rivals in Your Department
description:
Seo Seung-chan and Im Geon-woo are notorious for being arch-rivals on campus. One day, whilst working late, Im Geon-woo happens to catch Seo Seung-chan masturbating in a campus toilet whilst calling out his name. From that day onwards, Im Geon-woo begins to avoid Seo Seung-chan, and upon realising this, Seo Seung-chan starts approaching Im Geon-woo in a way that is quite unlike his usual self...
